en.headline: Lee attends City Hall ceremony marking victory over Japan
en.dek: The official commemoration of the 81st anniversary of victory in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression was held at 8am at the Hong Kong City Hall Memorial Garden.
body: Chief Executive John Lee and senior officials of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government attended an official ceremony at the Hong Kong City Hall Memorial Garden this morning to mark the 81st anniversary of victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.

The ceremony began at 8am. Those present stood for the national anthem as the national flag and the regional flag were raised. A police rifle honour guard fired a salute, after which the gathering observed two minutes of silence. Lee then led representatives from various sectors in a bow before the memorial niche.

Among those attending, according to official and local reports, were Liaison Office director Zhou Ji, Chief Justice Andrew Cheung, former chief executives Donald Tsang and Carrie Lam, Executive Council members, legislators, veterans' groups, district councillors, uniformed groups and youth representatives. The ceremony lasted about 10 minutes.

The National People's Congress designated 3 September as Victory Day of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression in 2014. The Hong Kong government has held a corresponding official commemoration each year since then.

zh.headline: 抗戰勝利81周年 李家超出席大會堂紀念儀式
zh.dek: 特區政府今早8時在香港大會堂紀念花園舉行官方儀式，紀念中國人民抗日戰爭暨世界反法西斯戰爭勝利81周年。
body: 行政長官李家超與特區政府高層官員今早出席在香港大會堂紀念花園舉行的官方儀式，紀念中國人民抗日戰爭暨世界反法西斯戰爭勝利81周年。
儀式於上午8時開始。全場肅立，奏唱國歌，升旗隊升起國旗及區旗。警察步槍儀仗隊鳴槍致敬後，全體默哀兩分鐘。李家超其後帶領各界代表在紀念龛前鞭躬。
據報道，出席者包括中聯辦主任周霽、終審法院首席法官張舉能、前行政長官曾蔭權及林鄭月娥，以及行政會議成員、立法會議員、退伍軍人團體、區議員、制服團隊及青年代表。儀式歷時約10分鐘。
全國人民代表大會於2014年將9月3日定為中國人民抗日戰爭勝利紀念日，特區政府其後每年舉行相應官方紀念活動。
